control_profile: position-stop only: ten-percent close-confirmed loss exit with six-bar cooldown and no volatility target, drawdown brake, time stop or turnover throttle
falsifier: The isolated position stop fails to recover positive long and short sleeves, at least four positive doubled-cost folds, positive chop Sharpe and gross edge above fifty basis points per turnover.
formation_horizon: one hundred twenty-six completed bars of market-residual risk history
hypothesis: The close-confirmed ten-percent position stop is the main useful overlay because it cuts violent fragile-coin squeezes and low-risk breakdowns before the next weekly rank refresh.
rebalance_horizon: weekly at the first daily boundary of the week
